status_vocabulary.EVIDENCED: Direct project evidence supports the scoped assurance activity.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: Some relevant evidence exists, but the complete control objective was not tested.
status_vocabulary.INCONCLUSIVE: Testing was performed but the available evidence does not support a final conclusion.
status_vocabulary.NOT_TESTED: The control was modelled but not technically exercised.

controls.note: Applicability and governance sources were analysed; this is not a legal compliance opinion.
Architecture, dependencies and trust boundaries are explicitly modelled.
Authentication was required to operate the lab, but IAM effectiveness was not independently tested.
Local balancing responded in both charge and discharge directions during Backend communication loss.
Telemetry source, timestamps and consistency were examined; comprehensive integrity attacks were not tested.
Failure state and timestamps were observable, but this is not a complete logging-control assessment.
Connectivity recovery was observed. Historical telemetry reconciliation requires direct central backfill evidence before full support is claimed.
Source revision and executable provenance are recorded. This is not a complete dependency vulnerability or licence assessment.
Physical and environmental dependencies were modelled but no physical hardware was tested.
Configuration and source changes are traceable, but a production change-management process was not tested.
Evidence lineage, timestamps and SHA-256 integrity records are implemented for the laboratory evidence set.
